title: Optimal and Efficient Contextual Combinatorial Semi-bandits with General Function Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2607.13686v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the contextual combinatorial semi-bandit (CCSB) problem, where at each round, the learner observes a context, selects a combinatorial action consisting of a subset of basic arms, and receives the reward of each selected arm; its goal is to maximize its cumulative reward over time. While many previous works focus on CCSB problems with linear reward function approximation, the design of efficient algorithms for the CCSB problem with general reward function approximation is limited. In this work, we study the realizable setting where the learner has access to a reward function class $\mathcal{F}$ that contains the true reward function, and propose the $\mathrm{SquareCB{.}Comb}$ algorithm. We prove that $\mathrm{SquareCB{.}Comb}$ achieves a minimax optimal regret bound of $O(\sqrt{m A T \log |\mathcal{F}|})$, where $A$ is the number of arms, $m$ is the maximum number of arms in a combinatorial action, and $T$ is the time horizon

translated_title: 具有通用函数逼近的最优高效上下文组合半赌博机
translated_abstract: 我们研究上下文组合半赌博机（CCSB）问题，在该问题中，学习者在每一轮观察一个上下文，选择一个由基础臂的子集构成的组合动作，并接收每个被选臂的奖励；其目标是在时间推移过程中最大化累积奖励。尽管以往许多工作都聚焦于具有线性奖励函数逼近的CCSB问题，但针对具有通用奖励函数逼近的CCSB问题的高效算法设计仍然有限。在本工作中，我们研究可实现的设定，即学习者可以访问一个包含真实奖励函数的奖励函数类 $\mathcal{F}$，并提出了 $\mathrm{SquareCB{.}Comb}$ 算法。我们证明 $\mathrm{SquareCB{.}Comb}$ 达到了极小极大最优的遗憾界 $O(\sqrt{mAT\log|\mathcal{F}|})$，其中 $A$ 是基础臂的数量，$m$ 是一个组合动作中所含臂的最大数量，$T$ 是时间范围。
tldr: 本文提出SquareCB.Comb算法，为通用函数逼近下的上下文组合半赌博机问题首次实现了极小极大最优的遗憾界 $O(\sqrt{mAT\log|\mathcal{F}|})$。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SquareCB.Comb algorithm, which achieves a minimax optimal regret bound of $O(\sqrt{mAT\log|\mathcal{F}|})$ for contextual combinatorial semi-bandits with general function approximation.
